The state holds a **fee simple subject to a condition subsequent (B)**. The "provided, however... may re-enter" wording gives the grantor a power to retake the land after a violation, so the estate does not end automatically. The shared note's reading, that development ends the estate automatically as a limit on duration, describes a fee simple determinable, which would need "so long as," "while," or "until" language instead.

CONFIDENCE: 85
